description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapView' which visualizes a mind map of recommended roles for a persona, including fetching data, filtering, and rendering related UI components.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes input to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined inputs.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts input to an array of strings, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes role ID from various possible role object properties.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role title from various role object properties.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range string to numerical min and max values in lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches selected industry, skills, and salary range filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations from external pool based on persona and mode.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts stored view state to viewport object with pan and zoom, applying zoom bounds.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport object along with selected node ID into view state for storage.
